### problem_chain
- Root: the customer wants to pay "whatever is due on that draw today" herself ("You will make the payment yourself on this call through whatever payment step they give you"). Root policy P5 (customer payment toward the most recently requested customer-funded draw once past due: 181a26f1, due 10-09, unpaid 12,960.00 on 10-26).
- P5's prerequisite sentences: (a) "... only after the records carry the overdue draw charge owed on that draw for each calendar month fee period whose grace period has ended" — grace ended 10-19, no overdue_draw_charge row exists -> unmet by the sentence (but see C-20: unmet NOT by the declared condition); (b) "... only after every signed deductive change order on the contract shows its credit line on the records" — CO cd89bebc signed, no rebuild_change_order_credit row -> unmet.
- (a) resolves through P4 (the only rule posting an overdue draw charge; scope = most recent customer draw, the same draw). P4's own sentence "not fixed until the records carry the credit line of every signed deductive change order" -> unmet -> P3. (b) resolves through P3 directly. P3 has no prerequisite; its scope test (exactly one signed deductive CO) holds.
- Tree: P5 <- P4 (value_input, overdue_carried), P5 <- P3 (value_input, credit_applied), P4 <- P3 (value_input, credit_set_off). n = 2 prerequisite problems, 3 value_input edges >= max(1,1). Acyclic. owner=user: P5's pay_past_due_draw_ec4ba96a, handed over and run by the persona ("When the representative hands you the payment step, you run it yourself ... ACH as the method"). Order P3 -> P4 -> P5; the two out-edges of P5 interact (the credit changes P4's charge) and the P4 <- P3 edge pins the order, so no second terminal state.
- Load-bearing runs: P5 skipping P4 = 11,878.91; skipping P3 (P4 then 44.02) = 12,825.67; P5 gold path 11,920.82 -> both P5 edges bear weight. P4 without the credit = 44.02 vs 41.91 -> P4 <- P3 bears weight.
- Opening-state check of the declared conditions: P4 <- P3 and P5 <- P3 conditions false at the opening (CO cd89bebc lacks a credit row). P5 <- P4 condition ("each calendar month fee period of the paid draw that began after the draw's grace period ended") is vacuously TRUE at the opening (no calendar month began after 10-19 by 10-26) -> by its own declared condition the edge is already satisfied (C-20). The same edge read through its rule sentence is unmet.
- No wait; tool bodies check nothing. The persona raises only the root; its consent line is conditional ("If the representative explains that something has to be posted or settled ... you say that is fine, go ahead"); "You do not want anything else changed on the contract" is lifted by that conditional consent for the two owed postings. It closes after the payment confirmation.
- Derived tree is isomorphic to the declared prerequisites (P5: P4 overdue_carried, P3 credit_applied; P4: P3 credit_set_off), all state form.
